context_sensitivity.provenance: Existing saved build snapshot: observed Behemoth levels and Signature agree with the video. Research levels and Behemoth exact star steps are candidate historical context, not independently established for the fight; evaluated separately from video-only inputs.

limits: Static replay paths load stored rounds, initialize replay hero ATK to 0 / HP to 100, and import report statistics. Animation-derived time is not established as authoritative original fight time.
Shared scaling and nuisance coefficients are fitted from these outcomes; no per-hero multiplier is fitted.
Survival is supplied from the replay rather than predicted. Targeting, movement, hit success, criticals and shielding are not recreated.
Hero rows include eligible owned actors; an exposure term is not a measured soldier or summon damage fraction.
The defence grid is a nuisance-shape probe; fitted DEF is not recovered enemy defence. Its grid boundary can hide missing mechanisms.
Leave-one-owner-out is an internal same-battle stress test; all five owners share the encounter and observations.
The shared incoming-budget offset is an empirical fit to reported damage taken, not recovered troop HP, Research, Behemoth stats or an effective-healing allocation.
Balanced global scoring includes survival and utility and cannot be calibrated against damage columns alone. No production weight is changed.
